title: Snapshot source translation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet with $k$ work tapes, and let $N,T,t\in\mathbb{N}$. Let $\ell$ be a list of Boolean circuit bit sources of length $N$, and let $\rho$ assign a natural number to each of the 11 registers. Suppose the register for the current snapshot index has value $\operatorname{snapIdx}_M(N,T,t)$, the register for the time bound has value $T$, and the register for the left boundary has value $t\,\operatorname{cfgStride}_M(N,T)$. Then translating each entry of the snapshot-source list of width equal to the number of possible snapshots, with its initial-time flag set to the indicator of $t=0$, gives exactly the list of bit sources specified by the tableau layout at time $t$.
